current.text: He signed a new contract and is the starting point guard.
Utah has Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. for a full season and added Darryn Peterson, so the usage is crowded.
Experts expect his usage to drop and do not expect him to repeat last season's 23.6 points per game. One expects him to lose about one assist per game.
His volume will drop over time, so he needs to learn to play and shoot off the ball or become a big distributor.
Tier 5 point guard. Still expected to be good.
The market overcorrects for the usage drop. Experts call him a sleeper at an ESPN ADP around 100 to 113 and a Fantrax ADP of 58.
Utah is trying to win this season. Experts think fears of tanking and late season shutdowns are misplaced.

durable.text: He broke out last season and arguably should have won Most Improved Player.
His rim finishing rose to 65 percent. The expert thinks he may be able to keep it.
Turnovers are his clear weak category, about 3 per game. FT% on good volume and assists are his best categories.

note: He went for 2 USD in our league last season. Yahoo values him at 24 USD (rank 43) but his average cost is only 7.2 USD, and ESPN has him at 3 USD (rank 89), so he should be a bargain if he goes near those costs. He fits punt TO builds and helps FT%, AST and PTS. Early in the season, check his shot volume: Yahoo projects 12.2 FGA and ESPN 15.9. Also check his assists next to Peterson and Jackson.
